physical_subject: Does adding the same amount to both scores change softmax?
relationship: Softmax is invariant to a common additive shift. Subtracting the maximum avoids exponential overflow; changing a relative score changes the normalized weights.
operation: Persistent share bar stays fixed under a common score shift; subtracting the maximum preserves its values; changing only one score visibly changes the bar.
closest_prior: Earlier neural-network overview and unit-sensitive nearest-neighbor film
substantive_difference: This proves softmax shift invariance and contrasts it with a changed score gap, not distance normalization or neural-network training.
